notes: SocialBranch: auto-upload base64 media to Supabase Storage before sending to webhook. New bucket 'social-media' (public, 10MB limit, image+video only). Instagram/Meta APIs require public image URLs — base64 wouldn't work. _uploadMediaToPublicUrls(media) decodes data URLs, POSTs to storage.v1/object/social-media/{file}, returns public URL list. Pass-through for URLs that are already public. _publishNow() now awaits upload before firing webhook.
